07/10/2026.report: A Atzeni stated that he was instructed to go forward but his mount was unable to cross runners to his inside which resulted in it being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event. He added that BEAUTY SHOW was further disadvantaged when MAPOGO was positioned to his outside which resulted in BEAUTY SHOW then weakening noticeably in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. The performance of BEAUTY SHOW was considered disappointing. Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY SHOW will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments. <14/10/2026 7 October 2026 Happy Valley Racemeeting – Race 5 (83)> Additional diagnostic assessments performed on the horse did not reveal any significant findings.
07/10/2026.quote: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. The performance of BEAUTY SHOW was considered disappointing. Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY SHOW will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.

09/09/2026.report: Shortly after the start shifted out and away from HARMONY FIRE and made contact with DOUBLE ALPHA. When questioned Z Purton stated that his mount was pressured in the lead in the early stages. He said on the Home Turn BEAUTY SHOW came under pressure and shifted ground and as a result in the Home Straight he did not fully test the horse to the finish of the event. Trainer F C Lor agreed with the assessment of Jockey Purton that the horse did not appreciate being pressured in the lead but could offer no other explanation for the horse’s performance. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. The performance of BEAUTY SHOW, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable. Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY SHOW will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

01/07/2026.report: E C W Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 1200 Metres (see CALL ME SUCCESS). Leaving the 400 Metres improved into a narrow run between CIRCUIT CENTURY and LUCK IS BACK and as a result made contact with LUCK IS BACK. LUCK IS BACK (Apprentice P N Wong) then shifted in, resulting in WINNING MACHINE being crowded for room between CIRCUIT CENTURY and LUCK IS BACK for some distance thereafter. Both E C W Wong, rider of WINNING MACHINE, and Apprentice Wong were advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances. Lay out under pressure over the final 200 Metres. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils. Before being allowed to race again, WINNING MACHINE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

21/05/2025.report: H Bowman, the rider of 5th placegetter, MIGHTY COMMANDER, pleaded guilty to a charge under Rule 100(2) in that he failed to ride his mount out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards. H Bowman was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 28 June 2025 and to expire on Wednesday, 2 July 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays). In assessing penalty the Stewards were satisfied that his actions had compromised the horse’s finishing position. When questioned H Bowman stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but his mount was bumped at the start and as a result he elected to obtain a trailing position behind JUMBO FORTUNE. He added that in the early stages MIGHTY COMMANDER raced keenly and approaching the 1000 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from SIMPLE HEDGE. After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on MIGHTY COMMANDER at the request of Trainer C Fownes. The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea. Before being allowed to race again, MIGHTY COMMANDER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. Sent for sampling post-race.

11/06/2025.report: Bumped at the start. After the event B Thompson reported that the intention was to hold an on-pace position. He said in the early stages when caught wide and without cover to the outside of GLORIOUS JOURNEY he attempted to go forward and cross that runner after the 1000 Metres but his mount did not show sufficient pace to do so which resulted in YODA’S CHOICE having to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. The performance of YODA’S CHOICE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable. Before being allowed to race again, YODA’S CHOICE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

09/04/2025.report: Shifted in at the start and was bumped. After the event, L Ferraris stated that his mount was able to lead but during the running of the race made a respiratory noise. He added that he endeavoured to increase the tempo on YODA’S CHOICE from the 600 Metres as is its usual racing pattern but the horse did not respond and gave ground under pressure in the Home Straight. Trainer P C Ng advised that, in his opinion, YODA’S CHOICE is better suited racing on the All Weather surface. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. The performance of YODA’S CHOICE, a last start winner, was considered disappointing. Before being allowed to race again, YODA’S CHOICE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

28/10/2026.report: When questioned C Y Ho stated that from the outside barrier he was instructed to ride ANOTHER WORLD conservatively. He said in the early stages he was able to shift his mount in behind runners and settle at the rear of the field. When questioned regarding his riding on the Home Turn and the early part of the Home Straight and if there was an opportunity to shift to the outside sooner than what he did, Jockey Ho stated that when he observed LUCKY BID shift out his intention was to improve between LUCKY BID and KYOTO SPRING, however, when LUCKY BID then shifted back in, ANOTHER WORLD was then disappointed for this run. He added he became held up for some distance thereafter before shifting to the outside of LUCKY BID near the 250 Metres where he was able to secure clear running. Trainer C H Yip confirmed the instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner to offset the outside barrier. He added that he also asked Jockey Ho to endeavour to look for inside runs in the Home Straight to save ground.

22/11/2026.report: Dislodged its rider on entering the track, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race. Near the 1100 Metres RAGING WARRIOR, which was racing ungenerously, shifted in and away from MR COOL, resulting in REGENCY DREAM shifting in and making contact with SHANNON GLOW. As a result SHANNON GLOW shifted in and made contact with TRENDY RUSH, resulting in SHANNON GLOW then shifting out and crowding the running of REGENCY DREAM which was steadied. As the Stewards were of the view the racing manners of RAGING WARRIOR and REGENCY DREAM were the principal reason for the incident occurring, no further action was taken. Approaching the 50 Metres was shifted to the inside of KING OF FIGHTERS to continue into clear running.

19/11/2025.report: When questioned Y L Chung stated that his instructions were to attempt to find a position midfield with cover. He said from the outside barrier VIVA CHALEUR jumped well and as a result was able to hold a forward position in the early stages. He added that with blinkers being applied for the first time VIVA CHALEUR over-raced throughout the early stages which resulted in the horse improving to the lead. He further stated that although he was aware that the sectional times were being run inside of standard time he was unable to set a more sustainable pace as VIVA CHALEUR was racing too keenly and would not respond to his efforts to come back. He said due to its racing manners VIVA CHALEUR weakened in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have an epiglottic entrapment.
19/11/2025.quote: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have an epiglottic entrapment.

25/10/2026.report: Jumped awkwardly, resulting in its rider K C Leung becoming unbalanced. Approaching the 500 Metres was contacted by LO RIDER which shifted out. Near the 150 Metres K C Leung dropped his whip. Between the 150 Metres and the 100 Metres raced in restricted room to the inside of SERAPH GABRIEL which shifted in. When questioned Jockey Leung stated that after settling in a midfield position to the outside of BIG RETURN, when the pace of the event eased near the 1500 Metres his mount became unbalanced when bumped by BIG RETURN which shifted out when being checked. He said as a result SUPER GOLDENDRAGON then commenced to race keenly and he allowed it to stride forward. He said as he improved forward the pace of the race increased and when CALL ME MAGNIFIQUE held its position to his inside he was unable to cross that runner approaching the turn near the 900 Metres. He said as a consequence he elected to remain racing to the outside of CALL ME MAGNIFIQUE before being able to obtain cover near the 700 Metres. He added that under pressure in the Home Straight his mount finished the race off only fairly which he attributed to the race not being run to suit. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse’s trachea.

05/07/2025.report: After the event Apprentice E C W Wong stated that soon after the start his mount blundered and as a result settled towards the rear of the field. He said throughout the early and middle stages his mount did not travel comfortably and did not respond to his riding to attempt to hold a more forward position. He added on entering the Home Straight when he was concerned there may be something amiss with AEROVOLANIC when it again blundered, he then retired the horse from the event. Trainer P C Ng stated that the horse had pleased him during the lead-up to today’s race and he expected it to perform well.
